professional.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ZPT Partners team website professional portrait, first half of a matched modern/maritime portrait pair.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and the sole source of Gavin's identity. Image 2 is a style and framing reference only, another ZPT team member. Never transfer the reference person's face or hair.
Primary request: Create a photorealistic ZPT version of Gavin's supplied headshot. Preserve Gavin's facial identity, young adult age, facial proportions, skin texture and small marks, light brown/blond tousled hair, eyes, open smile and natural teeth. Preserve the front-facing pose and his existing blue suit jacket, white shirt and patterned dark blue tie.
Scene/backdrop: Replace the existing room and stairs with the same warm cream parchment background treatment as Image 2, subtly weathered paper, faint thin geometric construction lines, restrained charcoal/navy rectangular blocks along the left margin. No room remnants.
Composition/framing: One standalone vertical portrait, 3:4 aspect ratio, intended export 766 by 1024 pixels. Match Image 2's upper-body crop and subject scale. Center Gavin, crown of hair near 9 percent of canvas height, chin near 53 percent, shoulders visible, torso extending to bottom, no hands visible. Keep comfortable headroom and the full hair silhouette.
Lighting/mood: Soft flattering but natural professional light, slightly warm coherent grading. Photographic face and clothing with visible real skin and fabric texture.
Constraints: Change background and crop, with only restrained lighting adjustment. Keep Gavin recognizably identical to Image 1, without face beautification, aging, slimming, hair redesign or a different smile. Image 2 supplies visual style only.
Avoid: text, logo, watermark, border, multi-panel layout, other people, nautical costume, painted face, plastic skin, invented accessories.

maritime.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ZPT Partners team website maritime oil-painted portrait, second half of a matched modern/maritime portrait pair.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and the sole source of Gavin's identity. Image 2 is a style and framing reference only, another ZPT team member. Never transfer the reference person's face or hair.
Primary request: Transform Gavin's supplied headshot into the established ZPT nautical oil portrait style in Image 2. Preserve Gavin's facial identity, young adult age, exact face structure, light brown/blond tousled hair, eyes, open smile and natural teeth. Keep the source's approachable expression and front-facing head and shoulders.
Scene/backdrop: Warm sepia parchment and old maritime-chart atmosphere, restrained sailing ships and sea behind the shoulders, faint compass rose in upper right, matching Image 2's warm ochre tones and subtle texture.
Wardrobe: Replace the modern suit and tie with a dark navy historical naval officer's coat, brass buttons, worn cognac/gold edging and an ivory linen shirt with an open collar. No hat, no medals, no new objects held.
Style/medium: A refined textured traditional oil painting, visible restrained brushwork and canvas texture, same degree of painterly realism as Image 2. The face remains clearly Gavin, youthful and naturally proportioned, with nuanced skin texture.
Composition/framing: One standalone vertical portrait, 3:4 aspect ratio, intended export 766 by 1024 pixels. Center Gavin at exactly the same professional team portrait scale: crown near 9 percent of canvas height, chin near 53 percent, shoulders visible, torso extending to bottom, no hands visible. Preserve source head pose and full hair silhouette.
Lighting/mood: Warm golden studio-like illumination, navy and ochre palette, friendly expression, heritage maritime atmosphere.
Constraints: The only identity is Gavin in Image 1. Retain his age, hairstyle, facial proportions and specific smile. Adapt only wardrobe, background, rendering and framing. Do not age the subject or add facial hair.
Avoid: text, logo, watermark, border, multi-panel layout, other people, pirate caricature, hat, weapons, invented accessories, dark obscured face, face from style reference.
maritime.final_alignment_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Final ZPT maritime portrait paired with a professional photo for a website hover transition.
Input images: Image 1 is Gavin's newly created maritime painting and the edit target. Image 2 is Gavin's matched professional portrait and the exact framing reference. Image 3 is Gavin's original photograph, for identity only.
Primary request: Make a composition-only correction to Image 1 so Gavin's head position and scale match Image 2. Keep the painting itself, identity and all visual styling. Reduce the head and figure scale by about 7 percent and move the head lower by about 60 pixels on a 1086 by 1448 canvas, matching Image 2's hair crown near 15 percent canvas height, eye line near 32 percent, chin near 52 percent, and shoulder framing. Keep portrait 3:4.
Scene/backdrop: Preserve the existing textured warm golden parchment, compass rose in upper right and small sailing ships behind shoulders. Extend or recompose the painted background naturally as needed.
Constraints: Preserve the exact same Gavin facial likeness, young adult age, tousled blond/light brown hair, smile, natural teeth, gaze and pose of Image 1. Preserve navy naval coat, brass buttons, cognac/gold trim and cream shirt, brushwork and color palette. Use Image 2 only to align head scale and position, without bringing its modern suit, geometric background or photographic medium into the painting. Do not redesign or beautify Gavin's face.
Avoid: new text, logo, watermark, border, multiple panels, extra people, changed expression, hat, new accessories, older-looking face, oversmoothed skin.
